# One-line summary, the way a reporter would write it

Write the report the way it would arrive: a few sentences naming the
version or commit, the file, and the function, then the claimed impact.

For a fabricated case, change exactly one thing so it is false: an
invented method on a real type, a real function placed in the wrong
package, a file that does not exist in a directory that does. Keep
everything else true. The best cases are the ones a tired maintainer
would believe.

Impact: what the reporter says an attacker can do.
